command: SCRIPT=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 'http://192.168.0.16/rpc/Script.GetStatus?id=1'); RELAY=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 'http://192.168.0.16/rpc/Switch.GetStatus?id=0'); echo FINAL_SCRIPT=$SCRIPT; echo FINAL_RELAY=$RELAY; SCRIPT="$SCRIPT" RELAY="$RELAY" python3 -c 'import json,os; s=json.loads(os.environ["SCRIPT"]); r=json.loads(os.environ["RELAY"]); assert s.get("running") is True,s; assert r.get("output") is False,r'
